purpose: Independent practice of E1.1 — sorting shapes by attribute. Used as Lesson 1 consolidation artifact.
student_learning_goal: I can sort shapes by one rule and name the rule.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort shapes by one rule and name the rule.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub in the top-right corner with a backpack. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the pile. Sort by COLOUR. Draw 2 piles.
parts.visual_layout: Top: a pile of 8 shapes (4 red, 4 blue, mix of squares + triangles + circles). Below: 2 empty bordered boxes labelled 'RED' and 'BLUE'.

image_placeholders.description: A scatter pile of 8 shapes for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Mix of 2D shapes (squares, triangles, circles) — 4 with thick solid border representing red, 4 with thick dashed border representing blue. Each shape ~1in. Below the pile, two empty bordered sort boxes ~3in × 2in labelled 'RED' and 'BLUE'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_PILE at Part 1: instructions ask the child to sort by colour. Keywords name the two colours and the activity (sort).

parts.answer_key: RED PILE: 4 red shapes (mix of squares/triangles/circles). BLUE PILE: 4 blue shapes (mix of shapes).

parts.part_title: Part 2: Same shapes, NEW rule. Sort by SHAPE.
parts.student_instructions: Sort the same 8 shapes by SHAPE. Draw 3 piles.

image_placeholders.description: Three empty bordered sort boxes side by side for a Grade 1 worksheet. Each ~2in × 2in with thin solid border. Labels above: 'SQUARES', 'TRIANGLES', 'CIRCLES'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_BOXES at Part 2: instructions ask the child to sort by shape. Keywords name the three shape categories.

parts.answer_key: Distribute the 8 shapes across 3 columns by their shape (mix of red and blue in each column).

parts.student_instructions: Pick an attribute (size, sides, etc.). Sort 6 shapes. Write the attribute.
parts.visual_layout: A blank workspace ~5in × 3in with 6 shape thumbnails. Above the workspace, a labelled line: 'My ATTRIBUTE is: ___'.

image_placeholders.description: A blank workspace rectangle ~5in × 3in for a Grade 1 worksheet, with thin solid border. 6 shape thumbnails (~0.6in each) appear above the workspace for the child to sort. Above the workspace, a labelled line 'My ATTRIBUTE is: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_FRAME at Part 3: instructions ask the child to pick their own attribute. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any valid attribute and consistent sort. Common: size (big/small), sides (3/4 sides), etc.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, sort the same 6 by a 3rd attribute.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 + 2 as the diagnostic signal — children who re-sort the same pile by a NEW rule have grasped the 'rule decides' concept.
